transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

Hi. Yeah, um... I guess what really brought me in is that my mind just won’t stay on one thing anymore. I'm a jeweler, and lately when I'm at my bench, I just jump around. Like, I'll go from reading a customer email to looking at a saw mark on a piece of metal, and then some noise outside catches my attention. And then I look down and realize I’ve completely lost the whole work order. It's just getting really frustrating trying to get anything done.
Do you often feel restless or find yourself moving around a lot, even when you’re trying to focus on a task?

Yeah, I guess I do get restless. But it's not just pacing around the shop or anything. It's more like... I just have to start doing things. 

Like, recently I just started lining up all these new commissions, messaging old customers, putting together a plan for a new website, and sketching out this entire Appalachian collection all at the exact same time. It just felt like I had to get it all moving right then, you know? I couldn't just sit still and work on the one piece in front of me.
Have you noticed needing less sleep lately, like feeling rested after just a few hours of sleep or not feeling tired even when you haven’t slept much?

Yeah, actually. For a while there, I was only sleeping maybe two or three hours a night. But the weird thing was, I didn't feel tired at all. I'd wake up completely clear-headed, just... really excited to start cutting stones or posting new designs online. I'd be up and working way before the sun even came up, and I felt totally fine.
Have you noticed feeling unusually happy, elated, or overly confident during these periods of increased activity or energy? Like you were on top of the world or couldn’t be stopped?

Yeah, I did feel like that. I did this craft show recently, and right after it, I just felt... lit up, I guess. Like I was larger than life and could do absolutely anything. But then, almost at the same time, if someone tried to tell me to stick to normal shop hours or told me I needed to slow down, I would just snap at them. I got really easily irritated if people weren't on my wavelength.
Have you noticed any periods where you felt down, depressed, or hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy, especially after these high-energy or excited periods?

Yeah, I have. Actually, these past couple weeks have been... really rough. It's like all that energy just crashed. I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling, like the shine has completely gone out of everything I do. I don't even care about the stones or the shop right now. I've actually sat in my truck and just... cried before going in to open up. It's just a really dark feeling.
